paper.title_en: Classical and quantum scattering of massive Klein--Gordon fields in asymptotically flat spacetimes
paper.abstract_en: We use microlocal tools to define distinguished incoming and outgoing vacuum states of the quantum theory of massive Klein--Gordon fields in non-trapping asymptotically flat spacetimes, including radiative perturbations of Minkowski space. The asymptotic vacuum states satisfy the Hadamard condition, and the incoming and outgoing particle representations are unitarily equivalent, or in other words the quantum S-matrix is well-defined. These results are based on a description of scattering of classical fields which keeps track of the asymptotic distinction between positive- and negative-frequency solutions of the Klein--Gordon equation. Our emphasis is on developing the theory without recourse to explicit asymptotics for classical waves.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在渐近平坦时空（包括闵可夫斯基空间的辐射微扰）中，利用微局部工具严格定义了大质量Klein-Gordon场的入射与出射真空态，并论证了Hadamard条件与量子S矩阵的幺正性；这属于弯曲时空量子场论与广义相对论基础中的核心散射问题，理论深度与方法的严谨性都较高，且不依赖显式渐近展开的路线具有新颖性，适合点击进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 渐近平坦时空中大质量Klein--Gordon场的经典与量子散射
decision.abstract_zh: 我们使用微局部工具，为非捕陷渐近平坦时空（包括闵可夫斯基空间的辐射微扰）中大质量Klein--Gordon场的量子理论定义了有区分的入射与出射真空态。这些渐近真空态满足Hadamard条件，且入射与出射粒子表示是幺正等价的，换言之，量子S矩阵是良定义的。这些结果基于对经典场散射的一种描述，该描述追踪Klein--Gordon方程正频解与负频解之间的渐近区分。我们的重点是在不诉诸经典波显式渐近展开的情况下发展该理论。
